name: Weighted Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a medicine ball or plate against your chest.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders a few inches off the floor.
cues: Breathe out as you curl up

common_mistakes.mistake: Too heavy, so the neck strains
common_mistakes.fix: Pick a weight that lets every rep stay slow

common_mistakes.mistake: Weight drifting away from the chest
common_mistakes.fix: Hug it close to the chest
Pause at the bottom of each rep
